spec_match.rationale: Exercises the 'only on valid interest sources' clause by mutating the real DOM, the following-sibling ordering after ::after, and the not-focusable / not-in-AX-tree clause via tab-stop counting.

interactive.rationale: Seven validity states, ::after toggle, tab-stop counter, and a working legacy toggletip (interestfor + popovertarget, aria-expanded synced from toggle).

edge_cases.rationale: Removed target, broken id, removed attribute, span, disabled button (unspecified, reported as 'observed' only).

conformance.rationale: Backs no-box-for-broken-target/no-box-without-interestfor and the manual not-focusable assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch, both without the flag and with --enable-blink-features=HTMLInterestForInterestButtonPseudo; console and network clean, 0px horizontal overflow on every run. Flag on: valid 48.2px, broken-id/target-removed/attr-removed/span 0, button 48.2px, disabled button 0 (observed), with ::after still 48.2px; tab stops before=2, after=1; legacy toggletip aria-expanded became true on click. No flag: every state labelled 'fallback: feature not rendering here'.

telemetry_health.rationale: Per-state validity asserts only in native mode; adds-no-tab-stop assert; initial assert checks 'matches spec' vs labelled fallback.

accessibility.rationale: Tab-stop count is a DOM proxy; the AX-tree claim needs DevTools confirmation.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes verified, table scrolls inside its own wrapper, 0px page overflow.

openQuestions.title: Disabled button behaviour
openQuestions.detail: The spec does not say whether a disabled button is a valid interest source; Chromium 153 generates no box. Track the HTML spec and update the 'observed' label if it is specified.

guidanceConsulted.query: touch-friendly info button next to link hover card interestfor
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Hints use popover="hint"; link triggers get role=tooltip + aria-describedby (never aria-expanded); position via the implicit anchor with position-area + flip fallbacks gated in @supports so unsupported browsers keep UA centring.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All hint popovers are popover=hint, role=tooltip; anchor rules are inside @supports (position-area: block-end).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible CSS generated content alt text decorative glyph
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use content: "x" / "" for purely decorative generated text; never carry meaning only in generated content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every ::interest-button rule uses content: "ⓘ" / ""; the meaning stays on the link and its hint.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce discrete outcomes in polite status/log regions; keep controls native and labelled.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts in role=status, events in role=log; native radios/checkboxes/buttons with visible labels and focus-visible outlines.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grids collapse to one column on narrow viewports, long tokens wrap, tap targets >= 44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column grids below 720px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code/readouts, 44px labels/buttons; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: DOM-mutation lab for source validity plus a measured migration comparison against a hand-rolled toggletip.
